utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey, Kira! Did you hear about the repair drive happening this weekend? They're fixing up old bikes for the kids.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, is that official? I heard something about it, but I want to make sure it's actually happening and not just a rumor.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's definitely happening! I saw the flyer at the community center myself — Saturday morning, rain or shine.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? I'm planning to bring my old lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, maybe... wait, is that this weekend or next?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: This weekend, definitely this weekend — I heard it from the community board myself.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Need a hand with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I'm not really sure what's going on with that drive—just heard bits and pieces while out and about.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I got the tools. Just say if you need to look at it together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Cleo, what's this about a repair drive? I haven't heard much about it yet.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, it's a community effort to fix up broken tools and appliances. We're collecting donations of old electronics and spare parts too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like a good way to reduce waste and help folks out. Do you know where I can drop off any old parts I find?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Jules, what time does the repair drive start next Saturday? I need to plan around the kids' soccer games.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It starts at 10 AM, but we usually kick off with coffee and donuts around 9:30 if you want to swing by early!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it, 10 AM start with coffee at 9:30. I'll try to make it after dropping the kids off at soccer. Thanks!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: When are we supposed to have those tools ready for the repair drive? I'd like to pencil it into my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I'm afraid I can't quite recall the exact date we settled on. Could you remind me again?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm not sure either, Oren. Let's figure out a date that works for both of us.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia! You heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I'm rounding up folks to help out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I heard something about that... but do we even have all the tools we'd need? I'd hate for people to show up and just stand around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Don't worry, Pia! I've been gathering tools all week — we'll have enough for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Rosa, I heard something about a repair drive going on—do you know what that's all about?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, yes! We're collecting gently used tools and offering free minor home repairs for neighbors who need a hand. I can put you on the volunteer list if you're interested!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds wonderful! I'd love to help out—please put me on the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I get started, can you walk me through exactly what happened with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Honestly, I'm a bit fuzzy on the details. Could you remind me what you're referring to?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure—the repair drive was the backup tool we were using to fix the console last week. Do you remember when it stopped working mid-repair?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll try to help with the repair drive if I can find the time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I might be able to pitch in too, but probably after the weekend — things are a bit hectic right now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: After the weekend works for me too. Just let me know what time you're free.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need any tools for the repair drive? I've got a full set in my garage if you need to borrow anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you have a torque wrench? Mine's been acting up lately.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I've got a torque wrench you can borrow. It's in good shape, just used it last week.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Bo, did you say the repair drive is at the old garage or the new one?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, I'm not sure—I think I heard something about the old garage, but don't quote me on that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'll mark that as unconfirmed for now. Let's see if anyone else knows for sure.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Rey, I heard you're fixing up that old drive. I've got a socket wrench set if you need one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, thanks Gus. I might take you up on that if my adjustable wrench keeps slipping.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, just holler if you need it—my garage is always open during the day.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are we sure everyone can actually make it to the repair drive? I don't want to start without a full count of tools and people.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we have a solid headcount, or are we just guessing again?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, I've been trying to check, but not everyone's responded yet. Maybe we should set a firm deadline for RSVPs?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, how's the repair drive going? Need any extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Jules, it's going well! We could always use another pair of hands if you have some time to spare.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I'd love to help out! Just point me to whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, I've been checking the inventory for the repair drive — we're running low on nails and lumber.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, that's rough. I could swing by the hardware store tomorrow morning and grab some more if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be a huge help, Dane. I'll make a list of exactly what we need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Faye, have you heard about the repair drive they're organizing next weekend?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh yes, I saw the flyers. I was thinking of bringing my kids' old bikes in—they've got a couple of wobbly wheels.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's a great idea! I heard they're also taking small appliances—my toaster's been on the fritz, so I might bring that along too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that. Hope it works out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I'm really hopeful too! We've got a great group of volunteers signed up already.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh awesome, glad to hear it's coming together. Let me know if there's anything quick I can do to help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I heard there's a repair drive happening. Need a hand loading up any old electronics or tools you're planning to donate?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I've got a few old drills and a busted laptop. Loading them into my truck now if you want to help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, I'll grab the laptop and meet you at the truck.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I heard about the repair drive—are you coming? I’m rounding everyone up for Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve heard bits and pieces about it. What exactly is the repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's a neighborhood thing where we all pitch in to fix up shared spaces—like that old bench by the park. I'm helping organize it, so I'm making sure nobody misses out!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you know where the repair drive is supposed to be today? I thought I saw it near the old oak tree this morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven't seen it yet this morning, but I recall the schedule said it would be by the oak tree around noon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Well, if the schedule says noon, then I must have been early. I'll keep an eye out later.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Has the repair drive been scheduled yet, or are we still waiting on parts?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check my notes — I remember you mentioned needing a specific part, but I don't have a confirmed date yet. Do you know which part is holding things up?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I'm not sure which part exactly — I thought you'd have that info. Can you check with the supplier?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Saw you hauling tools earlier — that repair drive still on for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! Saturday... that's this Saturday, isn't it? I think I put my screwdriver set aside for it somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good, you've got your screwdriver ready. I'll be there with some spare wood if the porch steps need patching.
